notes: every value is labelled from the producer's own text and the file it writes; a mapping whose producer does not mention the path fails the check
`--check` re-derives the classification, the mapping oracle and the file hashes; it does not re-run the producers' own checks (those are recorded from --write)
a fitted constant (FITS.md a/b) is DERIVED, not guessed: the fit, its inputs and its R^2 are all in the file and t1_fits.py regenerates it

one composite is neither: values.json's effective_base_colour applies a grabbed multiplier whose operator COLOUR_PARAMS.md marks UNKNOWN, so it is labelled ASSUMED and oracle `assumed_rules_cited` fails if that citation disappears
unknowns: VOCABULARY.md's per-member ranges are aggregates whose raw value rows live outside the repo (E:/Modding/_gamedata/JC3grab); the aggregate is re-derivable only where that data is present (jc3grab.py check)
no row in the seven files records a per-value hash, so 'file unchanged since the grab' rests on the producer's check, not on a value-level fingerprint
